title: Quaint Nutty Peruvian Potatoes Causa Limena
description: A romantic Peruvian dish featuring orange blossom water and flambe, this nutty causa limena is a unique and delicious experience. It is egg-free-friendly, making it accessible to a wide range of diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Boil the potatoes until they are tender, then let them cool.
Mash the potatoes in a bowl with a fork until they are mostly smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the chopped aji amarillo pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the orange blossom water and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mashed potatoes to the pan and stir until they are well combined with the onion and pepper mixture.
Stir in the chopped walnuts and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the potato mixture to a serving dish and flambe with rum.
Let the dish cool for a few minutes before serving.
